recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-key studio portrait of a woman with voluminous, frizzy blonde hair wearing a tilted dark hat. The composition features a clean, off-white background with minimalist, widely spaced typography at the top and a stylized logo at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hat brim creates a strong diagonal line that frames the subject's face.
The extreme letter-spacing at the top mirrors the horizontal width of the hair.
The dark clothing at the bottom anchors the light, airy tones of the face and background.
The texture of the frizzy hair contrasts with the smooth, flat planes of the background and clothing.
coreInvariants: Extreme horizontal letter-spacing for the top text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark diagonal of the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top wide-spaced text, moves down the diagonal hat line to the face, and rests on the bottom logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left and right of the neck, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), punctuated by deep black shadows in the clothing.
paletteRestrictions: No heavy gradients in the background
Limited to warm neutrals and black

letterConstructionRules: Bottom logo uses Art Deco proportions with elongated verticals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The bottom logo features interlocking or overlapping geometric characters
Top text uses very thin, light-weight strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A light, airy geometric sans for the header paired with a dense, vertical Art Deco style for the focal name.
graphicDevices: Overlapping geometric shapes (glasses icon) near the bottom logo

preserve: Extreme tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean lines of the top text.
Captures the tall, condensed Art Deco feel of the bottom logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 1980s-style voluminous frizzy blonde hair, wearing a tilted black felt hat and a black boat-neck top, against a solid cream-colored background. Use soft, high-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the very top with extreme letter spacing. Add a condensed Art Deco style name logo in white at the bottom center, overlapping the black clothing.

verificationChecks: Is the top text tracking wide enough to span the width of the hair?
Is the background a warm neutral rather than pure white?
Does the hat create a clear diagonal across the forehead?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
Specific wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the hair.
Check that the bottom logo is legible against the dark clothing.
Verify the lighting is soft with no harsh shadows on the background.
Confirm the color palette remains restricted to cream, black, and warm skin tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key 80s studio portrait with minimalist, ultra-tracked geometric headers and a condensed Art Deco footer logo.
